'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Thomas McCord DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas McCord]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Peace]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
